summary: Engine-independent map marker button for an application-defined point, location, or event with semantic intent color and a hover or focus caption.
useWhen: An application map needs an interactive marker whose icon and semantic intent describe an application-defined point, location, or event.
The map engine can mount a custom element and retain ownership of coordinates, anchoring, and camera behavior.
avoidWhen: The marker represents a vehicle, asset, person, or travel group with an operating state; use MapEntityMarker.
Several nearby points must be represented as one count; use MapClusterMarker.
The content is a legend item or non-interactive status swatch.
The component would be asked to own geographic coordinates, clustering, map-engine adapters, or selected-item business state.

alternatives.when: One map entity needs operating state, bearing, and an optional dashed outline.
alternatives.reason: MapEntityMarker owns entity operating-state semantics and geometry.

alternatives.when: Several nearby points are represented by a compact count.
alternatives.reason: MapClusterMarker owns cluster count formatting and cluster interaction geometry.

accessibility: The component renders a native button and label is its accessible action name. Prefer an action-oriented label such as ‘Open harsh braking event’.
Caption is a supplemental visual identifier and is hidden from assistive technology to avoid duplicating label.
Keyboard focus reveals the same caption as hover and uses the shared visible focus ring.
Intent meaning must be present in nearby map legend or application detail content; do not rely on marker color alone.
states: intent is application-controlled and selects the semantic map-marker color without inferring business state.
icon is application-controlled and accepts a canonical IcoMo icon name appropriate to the mapped point.

dimmed is visual de-emphasis only. The map owner decides when selection context should dim peer markers and keeps every marker operable. A dimmed marker returns to full opacity while hovered or keyboard-focused so its revealed caption remains legible.
Activation emits dsClick without changing application selection internally.
responsiveBehavior: Marker geometry stays fixed across breakpoints so map-engine anchors remain stable.
The map owner controls collision handling, overlays, and viewport-aware caption placement.

customElements: A map engine that accepts an Element for a custom marker or div icon can mount ds-map-marker directly.
Listen for dsClick and keep selected item, z-index, coordinates, and camera movement in application state.
react: Handle dsClick through the generated event binding.
angular: Keep map-engine marker lifecycle in the owning map adapter.

styling.rationale: The component owns stable map anchoring geometry and semantic intent recipes; the map engine owns host placement and stacking.

protected.reason: Marker geometry, semantic-intent colors, interaction treatment, and de-emphasis are one accessible visual recipe.
